```{r}
setwd("~/Desktop/Aiying/Data")
load("rsfmri.RData")
load("emoidfmri.RData")
cor_mat_rs <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(dim(rsfmri_ts)[1]), function(i) {
  cor(t(rsfmri_ts[i, , ]))
}),
rsfmri_subjectinfo$Subject_ID
)

cor_mat_emo <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(dim(emoidfmri_ts)[1]), function(i) {
  cor(t(emoidfmri_ts[i, , ]))
}),
emoid_subjectinfo$Subject_ID
)

```

```{r}
library(readxl)

y <- read_excel("wrat_pmat.xlsx")
y <- setNames(y$PMAT_pc, y$`Subject ID`)
y <- setNames(
  as.numeric(y),
  names(y)
)
y <- y[!is.na(y)]

ids_rs  <- names(cor_mat_rs)
ids_emo <- names(cor_mat_emo)
ids_y = names(y)
common_ids <- Reduce(intersect, list(ids_rs, ids_emo, ids_y))

cor_mat_rs_common  <- cor_mat_rs[common_ids]
cor_mat_emo_common <- cor_mat_emo[common_ids]
y <- y[common_ids]
```

```{r}
fisher_z <- function(r_mat, n) {
  z_mat <- 0.5 * log((1 + r_mat) / (1 - r_mat))
  diag(z_mat) <- 0
  z_scaled <- sqrt(n-3) * z_mat
  z_mat
}
z_matrices_rs <- lapply(cor_mat_rs_common, fisher_z, n=124)
z_matrices_emo <- lapply(cor_mat_emo_common, fisher_z, n=210)
```

```{r}
z_array_rs  <- simplify2array(z_matrices_rs)   # 264 x 264 x n
```
